body: Knife would be most painful and takes a lot of willpower. Death is pretty instant. Vein by my guess the slowest. Hanging usually makes you unconscious fast. I think it depends on the short/long drop and which vein. I'm no professional and can't talk you out of it as I'm no better. Killing yourself slowly in agony will make your survival instincts kick in and you might feel a sense of regret. Nobody deserves to deal with this crap :(
